finding: Autonomous resource-tool path calls ActionGateway.executeTool directly and records an event without standard finalizeToolOutcome in the reviewed path.
impact: Outcome/causal projection and external observation may be bypassed; effect risk depends on selected tool set.
fix: Route through one tool execution coordinator with stable job identity and exactly-once finalization for retryable effects.
acceptance: Call-site inventory has no unapproved bypass; replay does not duplicate execution or learning.

finding: Strong durable keyed receipt lifecycle exists, but guarantees apply only where callers use stable idempotency keys and central finalization.
impact: Unkeyed/retryable side effects can have weaker pre-execution durability and may need manual reconciliation.
fix: Classify tool effect; require stable key or explicit reconciliation for externally mutating/retryable operations.
acceptance: Crash/restart/failure tests show no automatic duplicate side effect.

finding: Ordinary cycle and external tool actions have useful but separate causal projections; same receipt lineage is not explicit in the reviewed finalizer path.
impact: Harder to reconstruct one external action→decision→outcome→observation→learning history.
fix: Receipt-keyed idempotent bridge and separate cross-tick trace verifier; retain current operational-cycle semantics.
acceptance: Receipt graph has exact IDs and no duplicate projections after replay.

finding: registerTool uses Map.set and silently overwrites an existing tool ID.
impact: A registration collision can replace executor/capability contract without explicit migration.
fix: Reject duplicate IDs; add audited explicit versioned replacement.
acceptance: Duplicate registration fails; explicit replace has audit/version and updated consumers.

finding: If executionId is omitted, resolution may fall back to tool name; simultaneous runs of same tool are ambiguous.
impact: Wrong outcome row could be updated if upstream caller omits correlation ID.
fix: Require execution/receipt correlation for trust and learning; tool-only match is diagnostic only.
acceptance: Missing/ambiguous key produces typed ambiguous-correlation without learning.

finding: Lifecycle command IDs are optional and the persisted replay receipt guard retains at most 512 entries.
impact: A retry after an old command receipt is evicted can lose deduplication; operation semantics vary.
fix: Stable command IDs for retryable writes plus explicit retention horizon/archive or reconciliation semantics.
acceptance: Repeated content revision/write after restore and outside hot window follows documented idempotent contract.

finding: Reviewed postMessage handlers check origin but not the exact event.source/window relationship; schema validation is limited.
impact: Same-origin messages from unintended frames/windows could spoof readiness or send viewer control messages.
fix: Require exact parent/owned iframe source; schema/range/allowlist validation and bounded payload.
acceptance: Negative tests for wrong sender/origin/type/value are rejected.

finding: Viewer has remote CDN fallback for runtime libraries.
impact: Offline reproducibility and dependency supply chain depend on remote hosts.
fix: Pin local assets or make remote fallback explicit opt-in with CSP/allowlist and offline behavior.
acceptance: Clean offline browser test shows deterministic outcome, with Legacy fallback available.

finding: Memory owner/write boundary is structurally strong; measured retrieval uplift remains unproven in archive reports.
impact: Adding Chroma/FAISS/embeddings by design alone may add cost without improvement.
fix: Promote retrieval candidates only with independent labeled temporal holdout and safety metrics.
acceptance: Holdout improvement beats baseline with no material epistemic/safety degradation.

finding: Production Vite build/browser E2E, real target inference/provider receipts, independent retrieval holdout, clean-room rollback, license sign-off and soak remain open.
impact: Implementation percentage and unit regressions do not establish release readiness.
fix: Run all gates on exact release candidate bytes and record artifacts.
acceptance: Fresh evidence for every P0 gate and no unresolved P0 blocker.

finding: Saved avatar mode is cast to union type without validating the stored string.
impact: Invalid persisted mode can lead to stuck or misleading view state.
fix: Normalize to exactly live2d|legacy; fallback to documented default.
acceptance: Invalid/old localStorage values recover to valid usable mode.

finding: Core is high-blast-radius; indiscriminate decomposition risks breaking persistence/trace semantics.
impact: Large rewrites amplify regressions and duplicate owners.
fix: Refactor only touched boundaries behind typed interfaces after behavior tests exist.
acceptance: Focused extraction preserves snapshots, migrations, receipt lineage and prior tests.
